result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback: it limits the restriction to Deerskin Products, applies only during the term and no later than 12 months after the Effective Date, and expressly carves out internal development and acquisitions. It removes the open-ended similar-products and similar-companies language while preserving the Deerskin brand exclusivity and unrelated term provisions. The drafting is generally professional, though the new carve-out paragraph would be clearer if numbered or expressly made part of Section 6.1.
